# The timeline split corpus: every series on which the two oracles,
# recurring-ical-events 3.9.0 and ical.js 2.2.1 (zones of @nextcloud/timezones
# 1.0.2, tzdata 2025b), answer differently and ical-rs answers as one of them,
# over the calendars and windows of agreement.tsv. Four tab-separated fields:
# the calendar, the UID, ical-rs's answer (as in agreement.tsv), and the oracle
# it agrees with (`rie` or `icaljs`). A refusal is an answer: a series of a
# calendar one oracle refuses lands here when ical-rs agrees with the other.
# Generated by harness/run.sh.
